summary: The first lighthouse on the St. Lawrence, lit in 1809 and kept for 137 years by four generations of the Lindsay family.

notes_for_editor: Story rests mainly on Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted, paraphrased) plus Quebec register and Canadian Register. Disagreements stated in text: Gilbert Lindsay death 1888 vs about 1891; automation 1972 vs 1969; octagonal vs circular tower; height 17 m vs 18 m. Lighthouse Friends gives Gilbert as keeper from 1867 and Rene appointed 25 Sept 1888; Canadian Register's 'René (1872-1848)' is evidently a typo. The 1900 report page 42 was matched by corpus.py scan p.57 printed p.42. Keeper dates from Lighthouse Friends' list; Lafrance 1964-72 from the same. Quebec classification (2022) taken from the register's status table (classement 2022-06-16). Parks Canada pages did not load text; Wikipedia not used.
